audit_objective: Determine feasibility of integrating RGB Drone, Multispectral UAV, and Palm Plantation agronomic data into a unified Multi-Source Risk Model.
direct_fusion_reason: No reliable common primary key, GIS boundary shapefile, GPS telemetry, or temporal alignment exists between the three sources. RGB and Multispectral data originate from different geographic regions (Malaysia Site 2 vs Germany Hullerbusch) and lack Block_IDs. Forcing a row-level join would constitute data falsification.

palm_plantation_agronomic.spatial_identity: Block_ID (B001-B044, 42 unique operational management blocks across estate divisions)
palm_plantation_agronomic.temporal_identity: Monthly series from 2012 to 2024 (13 years of historical continuous data)
palm_plantation_agronomic.feature_coverage: Complete agronomic profile (Yield, Plant Age, Palms/Ha, Foliar Nutrients N/P/K/Ca/Mg/B, Soil Chemistry pH/CEC/P, Weather Radiation/Rain/Temp/RH)
palm_plantation_agronomic.readiness_summary: Ready for core tabular predictive modeling and block-level agronomic risk scoring. The yield regression and high-production classification models are already successfully trained and validated on this source.
palm_plantation_agronomic.missing_requirements: Geospatial GIS shapefile / GeoJSON polygons defining exact block boundary coordinates on the ground.
palm_plantation_agronomic.recommended_next_data: Estate GIS boundary polygon layer (ESRI Shapefile or GeoJSON in EPSG:4326 / UTM).

rgb_drone_uav.spatial_identity: Image canvas pixel coordinates (e.g., 44000_16000_1013_87), NO Block_ID
rgb_drone_uav.temporal_identity: Single static flight campaign (unspecified exact flight date)
rgb_drone_uav.target_availability: NO (No direct FFB yield measured at the 1024x1024 tile level)
rgb_drone_uav.feature_coverage: High-accuracy object detection: 5 classes (Healthy, Dead, Small, Yellow, Grass), precision=0.960, recall=0.990, Drone Health Score
rgb_drone_uav.readiness_summary: Feature extraction and quality validation are 100% complete at the image level. Block-level risk integration is BLOCKED until a verified spatial mapping or GIS shapefile connects MOPAD Site 2 canvas coordinates to plantation Block_IDs.
rgb_drone_uav.missing_requirements:
1. Site 2 georeferenced orthomosaic header with CRS and affine transform.
2. Cross-reference lookup table linking tile offsets to plantation blocks.
3. Flight telemetry logs with GPS timestamps.
rgb_drone_uav.recommended_next_data: Georeferenced orthomosaic TIFF or spatial cross-reference lookup table for MOPAD Site 2.

multispectral_uav.feature_coverage: 43 quantitative vegetation-health features: pure-canopy masked NDVI, NDRE, canopy cover %, heterogeneity (CV), and Multispectral Health Score (MHS)
multispectral_uav.readiness_summary: Multispectral index calculations and feature engineering are 100% complete and validated. Direct fusion into Palm_AI plantation risk is BLOCKED because the current multispectral data represents a benchmark campaign (Hullerbusch, Germany) disjoint from the tropical plantation.
multispectral_uav.missing_requirements: Calibrated multispectral UAV imagery flown directly over the target Palm_AI plantation blocks (or equivalent tropical oil palm survey with known Block_IDs).
multispectral_uav.recommended_next_data: Co-registered multispectral UAV survey tiles captured over target oil palm plantation blocks.

multi_source_risk_architecture_recommend.immediate_architecture: Decoupled Multi-Pillar Risk Dashboard. Present Palm Plantation Agronomic Risk (Block-level), RGB Drone Visual Canopy Health (Image-level), and Multispectral Physiological Vigour (Tile-level) as parallel, independent evidence layers.
prohibited_actions: Do NOT force artificial row-level concatenation or merging.
Do NOT generate synthetic Block_IDs for RGB or Multispectral images.
Do NOT invent GPS coordinates for non-georeferenced images.
Do NOT claim NDVI or NDRE alone diagnoses specific pathogens (e.g. Ganoderma) or nutrient deficits.
future_fusion_prerequisites: Acquisition of plantation GIS block boundary polygons (Shapefile/GeoJSON).
Acquisition of georeferenced UAV rasters matching the plantation coordinate reference system.
Zonal statistical aggregation (e.g., rasterstats / zonal mean) mapping UAV pixels into block polygons.
